elements.title: Python code and output for correlation coefficient calculation
elements.details:
Code snippet: r, p = pearsonr(SP500, Nike)
print("Correlation coefficient: ", round(r, 3))
Output shown: Correlation coefficient: 0.923
elements.summary: This code snippet shows how to calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient between the S&P 500 and Nike stock using Python, with the output indicating a strong positive correlation of 0.923.
